_note: Flat params (CaseManagementPanel delete control: lensRun('law-enforcement','caseDelete',{id})). The delete half of the case lifecycle (F6), ABSENT at registry until this build — cross-check #70(b) found caseUpdate registered (edits) but no caseDelete in the 34 macros. Resolves the caller's own case by internal id or by case number (case-insensitive, trimmed) and removes ONLY the case row (le_cases via ctx.db, in-memory bucket fallback — same dual store as caseCreate/caseUpdate). Records filed against the case number are NEVER deleted with the case — evidence custody records above all stay on file — and result.linked reports how many reports/evidence/bookings/warrants remain under that number so the surface can say so. Owner-scoped: another officer's case id resolves as 'case not found'. The confirmation standard lives on the surface (two-step inline confirm in the Cases tab; no window.confirm).
name: caseDelete
